case: fits every dossier page at 390 by 844 and shows both counted packet digests on Review

host.browser: Google Chrome 120.0.6099.224 (local); hosted CI runs Chrome 157
host.note: Every run relaxes the inline citation's leftRange from [260, 390] to [0, 390]: on this host's Chrome 120 the citation lays out at left 200.95, outside the hosted bound, so the case cannot reach its hover step here unrelaxed. The relaxation is identical in the baseline and in every mutant.

command: npx vitest run --project e2e <path> -t 'fits every dossier page'
diagnosis: [Observed] Before the fix, on this host, the case failed on every run (6 of 6): the old scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant' }) left scrollY at 0 then 2 after two frames under html{scroll-behavior:smooth}, so the sampled point lay off-screen.
[Observed] An explicit window.scrollTo({ behavior: 'instant' }) moved the page at once; a smooth scrollTo took about 500 ms to settle.
[Observed] Inside a sources run the citation is display:inline-block with line-height 0 (the '.sources a' rule), so its box is 0 px tall.
[Inferred] On hosted Chrome 157 the same in-flight scroll moved the link between sampling and the trusted move, matching the bead's replay; not reproduced on Chrome 157 here.
